import json, re, random, sys, time
import chess

RULES = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open("re.json"))]


def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]


def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    out = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        c = b.copy()
        c.push(m)
        out.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return out


def check(fen):
    ours = run(fen)
    exp = expected(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(
        x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" extra:", [x for x in ours if x not in exp and x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" not in exp])
        print(" missing:", exp - set(ours) - {x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" for x in ours})
        print(" counts", len(ours), len(exp))
    return ok


ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
p = ex
for pt, r in json.load(open("re.json")):
    p = re.sub(pt, r, p)
print(repr(p))
assert p == "<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0" or set(p.split("\n")) == set("<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0\<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0".split("\n"))

random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300
fails = tested = 0
t0 = time.time()
special = [
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQ - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/5q2/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/3q4/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/4q3/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/1q6/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/1P6/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "rn2k2r/1P6/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/6P1/8/8/8/8/8/4K3 w kq - 0 1",
    "8/8/8/K2pP2r/8/8/8/7k w - d6 0 1",
    "8/8/8/3pP3/8/8/8/K6k w - d6 0 1",
    "8/8/8/2PpP3/8/8/8/K6k w - d6 0 1",
    "4k3/8/8/8/8/8/3pPp2/4K3 w - - 0 1",
    "4k3/8/8/8/2p1p3/8/3P4/4K3 w - - 0 1",
    "8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1",
]
for f in special:
    tested += 1
    fails += not check(f)
while tested < n:
    b = chess.Board()
    for _ in range(random.randint(0, 120)):
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        if not moves:
            break
        b.push(random.choice(moves))
    if b.turn != chess.WHITE or b.is_game_over():
        continue
    tested += 1
    fails += not check(b.fen())
print("tested", tested, "fails", fails, "time", time.time() - t0)
